summary: Tested the new Booked Date Reports feature end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases passing (list dates with report, ALREADY_REPORTED 409, UNDER_REVIEW on release-half, DATE_STARTED 400 on cancel after start, min-details 400, happy path report with photo upload + GET verification, private file access control, admin list, admin auth required, admin dismiss + admin refund_booker). Frontend: /dates page for ll_tester shows both seed bookings — rp-test-2 (accepted, started) with amber 'Date started' note, 'Report this date' button and NO cancel buttons; ll-test-1 (confirmed, open report) shows 'Reported — under review by support' badge and no Report button. Clicking Report opens the full form with all expected data-testids (reasons chips, details textarea, Add photo, hidden photo input, evidence link input, note, Submit Report). Seed data (ll-test-1 and rp-test-2) was restored at the end for subsequent iterations.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~5.1k LOC — consider splitting dates/bookings/admin into separate router modules for maintainability.

/api/dates/report/{bid} ordering: ALREADY_REPORTED (409) is checked before REPORT_WINDOW_CLOSED (400). Acceptable, but if a window-closed booking is re-reported it still returns 409 rather than 400; may want window check first for clearer UX.

InviteDates (POST /invites/{did}/report) does not raise ALREADY_REPORTED if a report already exists — a second call overwrites the previous report document. Consider blocking duplicates like booking_report does.
